keywords: 门限加密内存池结合 mev-commit 预确认
FOCIL 是否提升抗审查之争
提高点评估预编译 gas 的 EIP 提交
ERC-7246 与 ERC-7994 进入 Review
summary: Primev 与 Shutter 团队提出门限加密内存池结合 mev-commit 预确认，减少用户被抢跑的损失。nero_eth 认为 FOCIL 对抗审查帮助不大，soispoke 回应 FOCIL 本就不追求短期影响。marcindsobczak 提交提高点评估预编译 gas 的 EIP。

items.topic: 交易隐私：门限加密内存池
items.title: ethresear.ch：门限加密内存池结合 mev-commit 预确认
items.note: （pepae）21:12：Primev 与 Shutter Network 作者合写，用户每天因抢跑损失价值，交易在门限解密前保持加密，并由预确认给出打包承诺。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Threshold encrypted mempools with mev-commit preconfirmations
items.note_en: (pepae), 21:12: by Primev and Shutter Network authors; users lose value daily to frontrunning, so transactions stay encrypted until threshold decryption, with preconfirmations promising inclusion.

items.title: nero_eth：抗审查不是二元的，FOCIL 并未实质改善，只加快极少数交易的打包，却让大多数交易被广播两次
items.note: 21:24；soispoke：FOCIL 从不追求短期影响，只有在大规模审查已发生时它才会立刻起作用 16:28。
items.title_en: nero_eth: censorship resistance is not binary and FOCIL does not materially improve it, speeding up very few transactions while most get broadcast twice
items.note_en: 21:24; soispoke: FOCIL was never meant for short term impact, which would only show if massive censorship had already happened, 16:28.

keywords_en: Threshold encrypted mempools with mev-commit preconfirmations
the debate over whether FOCIL improves censorship resistance
an EIP raising point evaluation gas submitted
ERC-7246 and ERC-7994 move to Review
summary_en: Primev and Shutter proposed threshold encrypted mempools with mev-commit preconfirmations to cut frontrunning losses. nero_eth argued FOCIL barely improves censorship resistance, and soispoke replied it was never meant for short term impact. marcindsobczak submitted an EIP raising point evaluation gas.
